author: your-navi
description:
Dataset Details
	

Num2Txt is a dataset designed for converting numerical values into their textual representations in Indonesian. 
The dataset was generated using a tristage random sampling method:
Randomly select one of 7 groups (units, tens, hundreds, thousands, millions, billions, trillions).
Randomly pick a number from the selected group.
Skip duplicates to ensure unique entries.
This method ensures proportional representation, diversity, and no duplicates across 10,000 entries.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/your-navi/num2txt.
